title: Closed immersions descend along an fpqc covering of the target
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], and let $\{g_i:Y_i\to Y\}_{i\in I}$ be an fpqc covering [def-weil-pbc-fpqc-covering]. For each $i$, let $f_i:X\times_YY_i\to Y_i$ be the base change [def-pc-fibre-product] of $f$ along $g_i$. If every $f_i$ is a closed immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion], then $f$ is a closed immersion.

source.place: Descent, Lemma Tag 02L6 (label lemma-descending-property-closed-immersion): the direction from all fpqc base changes to f

proof.text: Install the already proved source theorem AlgebraicGeometry.IsClosedImmersion.descendsAlong_surjective_inf_flat_inf_quasicompact from WeilConjectures.Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.Morphisms.FlatDescent. It says that closed immersions descend along a single surjective flat quasi-compact morphism. Its complete source proof uses the finite-monomorphism characterization of closed immersions and the proved descent of finiteness and monomorphisms. This is an existing proved library declaration, not a new assumption.

The fpqc precover in the hypothesis generates a covering sieve for Scheme.fpqcTopology by Precoverage.generate_mem_toGrothendieck. Closed immersions are Zariski local at the target and stable under base change by Mathlib. Apply the already proved source theorem AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.of_isPullback_of_ofArrows_mem_fpqcTopology (WeilConjectures.Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.Sites.Fpqc) to P = IsClosedImmersion, f, the canonical projections pullback.fst f (g i) and pullback.snd f (g i), and IsPullback.of_hasPullback f (g i). Its remaining hypothesis is exactly the given family of closed-immersion hypotheses, so it yields IsClosedImmersion f.
